python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'tests')
import test_s3
import build
posts = {'post.md': test_s3.post_text(body='old text')}
patches = {
 'one.json': test_s3.patch_data('one','post','old',text='new text',at='2024-02-04T00:00:00Z',why='첫 정정'),
 'two.json': test_s3.patch_data('two','post','text',text='changed',at='2024-02-05T00:00:00Z',why='부분 정정'),
}
with test_s3.temporary_site(posts, patches) as root:
    content=root/'content'
    parsed_posts=build.parse_posts(content)
    parsed=build.parse_patches(content,parsed_posts)
    print([(p.patch_id,p.anchor,p.text,p.at) for p in parsed])
    states={p.post_id:build.PatchState(p) for p in parsed_posts}
    for p in sorted(parsed,key=lambda x:(x.at,x.patch_id)):
        print('before',p.patch_id,repr(states[p.post_id].body),[(i,u.text if isinstance(u,build.BodyUnit) else 'DEL') for i,u in enumerate(states[p.post_id].units)])
        try:
            states[p.post_id].apply(p)
        except Exception as e:
            print(type(e),e)
            raise
        print('after',p.patch_id,repr(states[p.post_id].body),[(i,u.text if isinstance(u,build.BodyUnit) else 'DEL') for i,u in enumerate(states[p.post_id].units)])
PY
